description: This file is a shell script containing automated tests for verifying the functionality of 'git svn log' and related Subversion (SVN) operations integrated with Git. It sets up a test repository, imports SVN history, and runs multiple tests to check revision ranges, ordering, and edge cases.

methods.name: setup repository and import
methods.description: Initial setup: creates SVN directories, imports them into SVN, and initializes corresponding Git SVN tracking.

methods.name: run log
methods.description: Executes 'git svn log' commands with specific revision ranges and filters to verify correct log output.

methods.name: test ascending revision range
methods.description: Tests retrieval of logs in ascending order over a range of revisions.

methods.name: test ascending revision range with --show-commit
methods.description: Verifies logs with commit details included.

methods.name: test ascending revision range with --show-commit (sha1)
methods.description: Checks revision hashes for the previous logs.

methods.name: test descending revision range
methods.description: Verifies log retrieval in descending order.

methods.name: test with unreachable revision
methods.description: Tests behavior when revision ranges include revisions that do not exist.

methods.name: test boundary revisions unreachable
methods.description: Assesses behavior when revision boundaries are not accessible.
